name: Ploiești

queries.query: Ploiesti Romania official cadastral parcel map GIS ANCPI geoportal
queries.result: First-party discovery identified ANCPI's official Imobile viewer, Geoportal INIS/INSPIRE, and ANCPI REST catalog. The official parcel-layer metadata advertises polygon parcels, anonymous query support, EPSG:4258, and id_namespace, but the live bounded request timed out.

queries.query: Ploiești România cadastru hartă parcele ANCPI geoportal oficial
queries.result: Romanian first-party discovery confirmed Primăria Municipiului Ploiești's Cadastru service, systematic cadastral-registration notices, and official municipal documents identifying OCPI Prahova / Biroul de Cadastru și Publicitate Imobiliară Ploiești. Municipal documents reference Geoportal ANCPI maps and parcel numbers but publish no safe anonymous parcel-vector API.

registryEvidence.custodian: Agenția Națională de Cadastru și Publicitate Imobiliară (ANCPI), through OCPI Prahova / Biroul de Cadastru și Publicitate Imobiliară Ploiești; Primăria Ploiești Cadastru is a local counterpart.
registryEvidence.scope: National cadastral and land-registration database and public visualization services, with local Ploiești systematic-registration and cadastral-administration evidence.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: ANCPI is the national registry/map custodian; OCPI Prahova and the municipal Cadastru service are local/regional counterparts. Registry evidence does not qualify a runtime adapter.
